_about: Assumed inputs, schemas and parameters for 4.7 drone lidar density ladder. Built 2026-11-05 by the build agent. Change freely. Path specs resolve through expkit: {key, rel} path_for(key)/rel, {exp, rel} the expansion folder, {area, rel} data/<area>/rel. 'assumed': true marks an input not held (VERIFY). The NETL request R2 has not been made.

ladder.nested_note: One shuffle seed per seed index at every rung, so each lower rung is a subset of the higher rungs (2026-11-06).

reclass.note: PDAL filters.smrf defaults, rerun on every rung (review 4.7-01). 2026-11-06 user accepted the PDAL defaults ("take defaults"). Change freely. Tuning on the native drone cloud against its vendor ground stays a later option.

raw_las.note: NETL drone point clouds as received (R2). Never edited. Large, F: preferred via config/paths.toml

provenance.note: Reply to the R2 request transcribed to JSON. site_selection is free text. sites_confirmed is a count or null

sites.note: The 63 potential well sites. Points (coordinates) or polygons (drawn features). Polygons match by IoU, points by distance

airborne_9t_score.note: 3.0 scorer output for 9t airborne (recall at K with interval). Keys recall, lo, hi

infer.note: The predictor reads data/<sfx>/derived/ and writes data/<sfx>/derived/inference/. Rung stacks therefore go to data/<sfx>/derived/, one sfx per rung and seed
